rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n and count values 1..n not divisible by 16.

rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n. Start x at 11; repeat n times: double x and add 13. Print x.
rows.target:

DISPLAYNL(x).

rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n; add evens and subtract odds from 1 through n, then add 1.
rows.target:

rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n. Multiply the values 7+i for i from 0 up to but not including n; print the product minus n.
rows.target:
